name: Sado Nee-san no Ecchi na Omocha ni Sareru Boku. "Sonna ni Saretara Mata...... Shaseichau!"
original_name: サド姉さんのエッチなおもちゃにされる僕。「そんなにされたらまた……射精ちゃうっ！」
source:
I live with my big sister named Yayoi. One day, my careless words changed her attitude dramatically. Since that day, I became her mare masochist slave.
